description: Analyze a text passage for overused industry jargon using a tech, finance, consulting, startup, or combined dictionary. Returns buzzword count, density score (0-100), severity level, flagged terms, and an optional roast critique when roast=true.

examples.content: We need to leverage our core competencies to synergize stakeholder value and create a paradigm shift in the marketplace through disruptive innovation.
Our blockchain-based AI platform utilizes machine learning to enable seamless integration across the cloud ecosystem for maximum scalability.

roast.description: Get a roast of your writing

name: buzzword_density_analyze

buzzword_count.description: Total number of buzzwords found in the text

density_score.description: Buzzword density score on a scale of 0-100

flagged_terms.description: List of identified buzzwords and their frequency

count.description: Number of times the buzzword appears

roast.description: Humorous critique of the writing (when roast_mode=true)

title: Buzzword Density Analyze
